normal.title: Normal egress
normal.description: 70,000 people leave the Coliseum after the final whistle.

expo_line_delay.title: Expo Line delay
expo_line_delay.description: E Line signal failure: no trains leave Expo Park/USC from minute 10 to minute 25.

bmo_event.title: BMO Stadium event
bmo_event.description: An event at BMO Stadium lets out: about 400 extra people per minute join the station walkway from minute 15 to minute 35.

sensor_outage.title: Walkway sensor outage
sensor_outage.description: The Bluetooth counters on the station walkway are out of service from the final whistle (minute 0 to 60). The crowd itself is the same as normal egress.
